Name: Shane Revised (CP)
Author: stanloona420
Description:
A li'l content patcher mod for Shane in my usual style. Not much to say about it! 
This mod replaces his normal and beach portraits as well as his beach character sheet, but not his regular character sheet. I figured the change would barely be noticeable anyway, I hope it won't bother you!
